protocol.note: Searches used grouped OR-queries (one query per template per company), not exhaustive keyword-level searches. Same five templates for every company; no buyer names or deal terms.
protocol.search_tool: Claude Code WebSearch (standard mode); results recorded in the order returned

templates.T1: "<name>" acquisition OR acquires OR sale OR sold
templates.T2: "<name>" advisers OR adviser OR "strategic review" OR "exploring options"
templates.T3: "<name>" CFO OR "chief financial officer" OR chair OR appoints
templates.T4: "<name>" investment OR funding OR backed OR "private equity"
templates.T5: "<name>" "invests in" OR "majority stake" OR "management buyout" OR "Series A" OR "Series B" OR "Series C"

protocol.selection_rule: In result order, open results whose title or URL contains one of the company's aliases (token match, case-insensitive), up to the per-template limit. Skip disallowed sites and URLs already opened for that company. No judgement of headlines.
protocol.source_type_rule: press_release if the domain is the company's own site, a PR wire or an investor (PE/VC) site listed above; otherwise news.
